result.summary: Checked the food delivery app page for visual breaks while excluding specified acceptable clipped content; found one minor content truncation issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a truncated name, displayed as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of its full, complete title.
issues.suggestion: Modify the card layout to accommodate the full restaurant name, or implement an ellipsis with a tooltip/long press to reveal the full name.
